# Toolpath Primer

> A plain guide to CNC Simulator Pro: what it simulates, what the licence costs, what your PC needs and how to start the trial.

Independent guides to CNC Simulator Pro by Toolpath Primer. Facts come from the vendor's pages on the date shown on each page.

## Decide
- [CNC Simulator Pro review: a broad G code trainer with a four axis ceiling](https://cnc-simulator-pro.github.io/review.html): CNC Simulator Pro review based on the vendor's documentation: 40+ machines, SimCam CAD/CAM, collision checks, Windows only, annual or perpetual licence.
- [CNC Simulator Pro pricing: annual subscription or perpetual licence](https://cnc-simulator-pro.github.io/pricing.html): CNC Simulator Pro price per the vendor's help desk: USD 99 a year with updates or USD 535 once without free updates. Refunds, trial, activation.
- [CNC Simulator Pro free trial: what you get and what happened to the free version](https://cnc-simulator-pro.github.io/free-trial.html): Is CNC Simulator Pro free? The installer runs as a trial without a licence, free licences ended in January 2026, and legacy 3.2 stays for old PCs.

## Do it
- [Download CNC Simulator Pro: official installer, trial and setup steps](https://cnc-simulator-pro.github.io/download.html): Download CNC Simulator Pro safely: official installer for Windows 10+ 64 bit, .NET 4.8, trial included, SmartScreen prompt and legacy 3.2 explained.
- [CNC Simulator Pro system requirements and the common start up errors](https://cnc-simulator-pro.github.io/system-requirements.html): CNC Simulator Pro system requirements: Windows 10+ 64 bit, .NET Framework 4.8+, a modern GPU, and what to do about graphics, plugin and SmartScreen errors.

## Compare
- [CNC Simulator Pro vs CAMotics: paid trainer or free open source simulator](https://cnc-simulator-pro.github.io/vs-camotics.html): CNC Simulator Pro vs CAMotics: machine types, CAD/CAM, platforms, licence and price compared, and which simulator fits a school, a hobby router or a shop.
- [CNC Simulator Pro alternatives: six G code simulators and verifiers](https://cnc-simulator-pro.github.io/alternatives.html): Alternatives to CNC Simulator Pro for hobby routers, job shops and production: CAMotics, NC Viewer, CIMCO Edit, G-Wizard Editor, VERICUT and NCSIMUL.
